name: XP Progression
description: Prototype fixture validating banked kill XP, ordered gated level application, seeded resource growth, and the selected content-owned two-speed combat-add schedule. The level-1 character earns 600 XP and applies levels 2 through 4.

research_boundary.notes: Original project names, text, layout, XP values, thresholds, and resource-growth tuning. Combat-add cadence is a successor-owned selected class-separated schedule, encoded as sparse per-level deltas rather than cumulative totals.
